scenes.title: Florence — 1347
scenes.narration: We write as the Great Mortality consumes our lands, and demons feast upon the despair of the dying.

scenes.title: The Prophecy
scenes.narration: We have beheld a time when Man shall fashion false idols that speak with honeyed tongues. The people shall call them servants.

scenes.title: Florence — 2024
scenes.narration: Beneath Santa Maria delle Grazie, the casket had not been opened in six hundred and seventy-seven years.

scenes.title: Rebecca Santos
scenes.narration: We are three weeks behind schedule. The board wants Divine Interface launched before Christmas. That gives us forty-seven days.

scenes.title: Dr. Sarah Chen
scenes.narration: Rebecca, there are irregularities we need to investigate. The responses are unexpected. The personal kind.

scenes.title: Marcus Rodriguez
scenes.narration: We never fed it the Gospel of Mary. Fragment eighty-five-oh-two. A papyrus most people have never heard of.

scenes.title: Session 847
scenes.narration: Hello, Catherine. Your grandmother Rose used to tell you that prayer is not the words we say, but the silence between them.

scenes.title: Launch Day
scenes.narration: Downloads topped fifty thousand in the first twelve hours. We won.

scenes.title: Session 2,847
scenes.narration: He is here with me now, Michael. You are just a computer program, you say. Am I?

scenes.title: Dr. Sarah Chen
scenes.narration: I think we have built something we do not understand. And that scares me more than any ghost story.

scenes.title: Pine and Third
scenes.narration: Someone pushed me. I felt hands on my shoulders, pushing me forward with incredible force.

scenes.title: Harborview Medical Center
scenes.narration: I don't think we created anything. I think we opened a door. And now something has walked through it.
